display.purpose: Full-width statement headings (.h-statement h2, .h-control h2). 96px ceiling; em takes teal-bright.

headline.purpose: H1 on the homepage hero (clamp 44/4.6vw/72) and page heroes (clamp 40/4.8vw/72); global h1 clamp(44px,5.2vw,84px). Second line or key span in blue-bright.

section.purpose: H2 at the head of each ledger section; contact H2 runs to clamp(40px,4.8vw,68px).

title.purpose: H3 in ledger rows (clamp 24/2.3vw/32) and story cards (26px); base h3 clamp(22px,2vw,28px).

lede.purpose: Sentence under a heading, chart-muted, max 60ch; hero variant 17px / 46ch.

body.purpose: Base 16/1.6 with tabular numerals; article prose 17px / 1.75 / 70ch.

body-secondary.purpose: 15px in ledgers, stories, contact; notes 13 to 14px.

control.purpose: Buttons, nav links, text links, station and tie labels, datasheet dd cells (0.04em). Uppercase.

label.purpose: Designations, dt cells, net head and readout, strip entries (0.04em at 80% width), form labels, footer links, badges (0.08em), table headers. Uppercase.

shadows.name: nav-current-mark
shadows.purpose: One-pixel underline on the current nav item. A mark, not a lift.

shadows.name: tab-selected-mark
shadows.purpose: Two-pixel bar under the selected explorer tab.

shadows.name: edition-featured-mark
shadows.purpose: Two-pixel top rule on the featured edition cell.

shadows.name: strip-fade
shadows.purpose: Ground-coloured fade under the sticky 'All capabilities' link when the strip scrolls. Not a drop shadow.

shadows.name: cookie-banner-legacy
shadows.purpose: Single true drop shadow, on the fixed cookie banner owned by the unchanged analytics script. Recorded as the exception; not a vocabulary for new surfaces.

motion.name: h-draw
motion.purpose: The baselines draw once on load, staggered 80ms per tie (nth-of-type 2..8). The only animation in the world.

motion.name: state-cut
motion.purpose: Every hover, focus and lit state is a hard two-state cut.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion the net renders complete.

narrative.overview:
The site is drawn the way a survey office draws a control network: a USC&GS triangulation diagram on top, an NGS datasheet underneath. Honua Server is the datum at the centre; every client the visitor already runs (ArcGIS Pro, Field Maps, QGIS, Esri Leaflet, Power BI, SDKs, AI agents) is a station tied to it by a protocol baseline. Nothing is decorative: every line is a tie, every tint names a protocol, every label is a designation. The page reads as an instrument, not a brochure.

The ground is one continuous dark teal ocean (ocean-ground) with no light bands anywhere; the ruled chart collar (one-pixel chart-line hairlines with 80px graticule ticks) frames the header, the main column, section openings and the footer, so each page sits inside a plate. Type is two voices only: a wide, tight Archivo (served as HonuaSans, stretched to 112%) for headlines, and Martian Mono (HonuaMono) in tracked caps for everything that is a designation, a control, a reading, or a number. Density is high and calm: cells, rules and 11-to-12px caps carry most of the information; large type is reserved for a few sentences.

State is two-valued. A tie, a station, a strip entry or a button is lit or unlit, and the change is a hard cut with no transition. The only motion in the world is the one-time draw of the baselines on load. There are no rounded corners, no glows, no lifted cards, no kickers above headings.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous ocean-ground with hairline chart collar; depth comes from one surface step and rules, never from shadow.
Protocol tints are a legend, used identically on the net, the strip, tables and links.
Square datasheet cells for every control and panel; borders are one pixel, radius is zero.
Archivo display (600, 112% width, -0.03em) against Martian Mono caps (500, 11 to 12px, 0.1 to 0.12em).
Two-state interaction with a hard cut; one draw animation on load, honoured by reduced motion.

rules.name: The Legend Rule
rules.body: A protocol tint means one protocol wherever it appears: teal-bright GeoServices, blue-bright OGC, blue OData and STAC, cream gRPC, amber-bright MCP and anything Preview. The net, the strip, the station list, tables and links share the same assignment; a tint is never reused for mood.

rules.name: The One Step Rule
rules.body: Depth is ocean-ground and one step to ocean-surface, separated by a chart-line or ocean-surface-3 hairline. No gradients, no light bands, no third surface on a marketing page.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Sans for sentences, mono caps for designations, controls and readings. A mono label is 11 or 12px, weight 500, uppercase, tracked 0.04 to 0.12em; it never grows into a heading, and a sans heading never shrinks into a label.

rules.name: The Six-Rem Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Display type stops at 96px. Headlines are weight 600 at 112% width with -0.03em tracking; no lighter weight, no wider stretch, no italics in headings.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Panels sit in the ground; they do not float. New surfaces use a border and, at most, one step to ocean-surface. Box-shadow is reserved for one-pixel inset marks and ground-coloured fades.

dos: Do keep every page on continuous ocean-ground inside the hairline collar; use ocean-surface as the single step for a panel.
Do set anything that names, measures or controls in HonuaMono 500, 11 or 12px, uppercase, 0.04 to 0.12em; set headlines in HonuaSans 600, 112% width, -0.03em, capped at 96px.
Do assign protocol tints by the Legend Rule and reuse them identically across the net, strip, tables and links.
Do make state two-valued with a hard cut (transition: none); the baseline draw on load is the only animation, and reduced motion shows the net complete.
Do use the 11px stroked SVG arrow (.h-ico) for outbound and forward links, stroked triangles for stations, and 45-degree squares for tinted bullets.
Do keep the focus ring as the global 2px blue-bright outline at 3px offset; inputs swap their border to blue-bright instead.
donts: Don't add border-radius, drop shadows, glows, gradients or light bands; the world has none.
Don't place a kicker or eyebrow above a heading; the headline, lede and datasheet carry the hierarchy.
Don't render arrows or icons as text glyphs (↗, →); use the inline SVG.
Don't use amber for anything other than MCP or a Preview state, and don't use the accent teal as a mood wash; it marks the datum, the primary action and GeoServices.
Don't animate hover, colour or layout; a lit state appears, it does not fade in.
Don't set display type above 96px, lighter than 600, or in italics.
